full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media close-up shows a woman's blue-eyed face assembled from translucent watercolor, dark drawing, and irregular paper fragments. The portrait fills nearly the entire frame, with the top of the head and lower chin cropped so that the eyes, nose, and lips dominate. The background is largely absorbed into the face; deep indigo and charcoal shapes at the left and right edges act like a narrow shadowed frame. Across the upper half, two cool blue eyes look directly outward beneath dark brows and dense lashes. The eye on the left sits in a deeper pool of black and rusty red, while the eye on the right is set in pale cream, gray, and blue washes. The bridge and tip of the nose occupy the center, modeled with broken ochre, rose, and gray planes. At the lower center, softly parted red lips receive fine dark contours and a small pale highlight. Broad orange-red patches cross the left cheek, while the right cheek is built from layered pale rectangles, delicate lines, and transparent washes. Some fragment edges are straight and angular; others feather into pigment blooms, making the face alternate between a coherent likeness and a visibly constructed surface. Faint printed marks and gridlike seams lie under the paint, too fragmented to read as text. The composition has little conventional depth, but overlaps of torn paper and watercolor stains create a shallow, tactile relief. Light appears broad and frontal, catching the pale central planes of the face and blue irises while the outer edges fall into ink-heavy darkness. The overall composition is immediate and intense, using a direct gaze to hold together fractured warm and cool fields of paper, pigment, and line.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒材特写呈现一张蓝眼睛女性面容，由半透明水彩、深色线描和不规则纸片拼接而成。肖像几乎填满画幅，头顶和下巴下缘都被裁去，让眼睛、鼻子和嘴唇占据主导。背景大体被面部吸收，左右边缘的深靛蓝和炭黑形状像一道狭窄暗框。上半幅两只冷蓝眼睛在深色眉毛和浓密睫毛下直视画外。左侧眼睛置于更深的黑色与锈红色中，右侧眼睛则落在浅奶油、灰与蓝色洗痕里。鼻梁和鼻尖占据中央，由断续赭色、玫瑰与灰色平面塑形。下部中央微启的红唇带细深轮廓和一点浅色高光。宽阔橙红色片横过左颊，右颊则由层叠浅色矩形、纤细线条与透明色洗搭建。一些碎片边缘笔直有角，另一些羽化进颜料渗痕，使面孔在完整肖像与明显组接的表面之间交替。颜料下有隐约印刷痕迹和网格状接缝，过于破碎，无法作为文字辨读。构图缺少传统纵深，撕纸与水彩污渍的重叠却形成浅而可触的浮层。光线宽阔、偏正面，照亮面部中央的浅色平面和蓝色虹膜，外缘则陷入墨色重影。整体构图直接而强烈，用直视目光把冷暖交错的纸、颜料与线条碎片维系在一起。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media surface combines translucent watercolor staining with angular collage seams, faint printed residue, and firm graphite-like contours. A recognizable central volume is built from many small, imperfect planes rather than one continuous smooth gradient. Cool blue and indigo contrast with rusty red, burnt orange, rose, and warm cream; dark areas gather at the edges while lighter fragments bring the focal structure forward. Pigment blooms and soft washes flow across cut-looking rectangular pieces, creating friction between fluid color and rigid geometry. Fine lines supply precise local definition, but the edges of larger shapes remain broken and layered. Broad frontal illumination keeps the middle luminous, and dense peripheral ink creates a shallow vignette without photographic blur. The overall effect is intimate, tactile, and slightly unsettled, with vivid color and fractured paper texture held together by disciplined value structure.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒材表面把半透明水彩污渍与棱角拼贴接缝、淡薄印刷残痕和坚实铅笔般轮廓结合起来。可辨的中央体积由许多不完美小平面搭建，而不是一条连续光滑渐层。冷蓝和靛蓝对照锈红、焦橙、玫瑰与暖奶油色；深色在边缘聚集，较浅碎片把焦点结构推向前方。颜料渗花与柔软色洗流过仿佛裁切出的矩形纸片，让流动色彩与刚性几何产生摩擦。细线提供准确的局部界定，大形状的边缘却保持断裂和叠层。宽阔正面光感让中央明亮，外围浓重墨色形成浅暗角而不依赖摄影虚焦。整体效果亲密、可触且略带不安，鲜活颜色与破碎纸纹由严谨的明度结构维系。
theme_en: A blue-eyed face assembled from watercolor and torn paper fragments
theme_zh: 由水彩与撕纸碎片拼成的蓝眼睛面容
name: Paul Lovering
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
